exerciseNotes.blockTitle: Incline DB Curl / Hammer Curl Superset

exerciseNotes.notesText: neutral v grip attachment for rows, straight bar for shrugs

skull crushers: keep elbows in
keep weights together to lock in elbow position consistency

leg press notch 8 for quads.

calf notch 11

ab notch 3
back notch 1
crunch, keep butt in seat

exerciseNotes.blockTitle: DB Romanian Deadlift / Calf Raise Superset
exerciseNotes.notesText:
notch 11
calves: aim for full extension, consider dropping weight and focus on full extension with hold to work top of calf
focus more on extension 

rdl, slow 3s down, 1s up

exerciseNotes.blockTitle: Superset: DB Fly / DB Lateral Raise
exerciseNotes.notesText: fly: at bottom, hands just outside  elbows, but at top, straighten arms and try to squeeze elbows together

leg press notch 8 for quads.

calf notch 11
